models.label: Popularity
models.desc: Baseline: most-watched first, the same list for everyone.

models.label: MF
models.desc: Matrix factorisation (LightGCN with 0 layers): one vector per user and per anime.

models.label: LightGCN
models.desc: GNN: 3 layers of neighbour averaging over the user–anime graph.

models.label: LightGCN + KG
models.desc: GNN over the user–anime graph plus the KG's genre, studio and other content edges.

models.label: DistMult
models.desc: KG embedding: score = user · rated · anime (element-wise).

models.label: TransE
models.desc: KG embedding: user + rated should land near the anime.
